title: UPI safety
summary: Keep your UPI PIN private and know when it is, and is not, needed.
keyFact: A UPI PIN is only for sending money. You never need it to receive money.

title: Fraud response
summary: What to do, and in what order, when something goes wrong.
keyFact: Act quickly. Banks have 24×7 helplines, and the national cybercrime helpline is 1930.

title: Reversals and disputes
summary: How to raise a complaint when money goes to the wrong place.
keyFact: Start with your payment app and your bank. NPCI has a dispute redressal process if it is not resolved.

title: Interest and credit
summary: Understand the full cost of borrowing before you say yes.
keyFact: RBI regulates lenders and NBFCs. Check a lender before you share anything.

title: Phishing indicators
summary: Spot urgency, odd links and requests for secrets.
keyFact: Be suspicious of any message that pushes you to act fast or asks for your PIN or OTP.
